name: Osananajimi
source:
Main character is a student approaching graduation. One day he gets a message that all his family dies in a traffic accident. He returns to his home town for the funeral and reunites to many childhood friends. The rest of his school life he spends in this town.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名临近毕业的学生。一天，他收到全家在交通事故中丧生的消息。他回到故乡参加葬礼，与许多青梅竹马重逢。余下的校园生活，他将在这座城镇度过。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
